title: skills: objectstack-data says a MongoDB before* unit needs a replica set "read in code, not measured"; #34563 measured it
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (published skill text the measurement made stale) · Source: fleet (the #34563 measurement, PR #37990)

## What happens

PR #37990 rewrites `hooks.mdx` and the objectql CHANGELOG to the #34563 measurement. Two skill sentences still carry the old reading:

- [ ] `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md:60` (the `before*` Transaction cell): "MongoDB needs a replica set (read in code, not measured)". Expected: the measured wording, and the PostgreSQL / MongoDB replica-set rule that a failed `ctx.api` statement refuses the outer write even when caught, logged or retried (SQLite lets it through).
- [ ] `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` near line 317: the same "not measured" reading in a case's expected output. Expected: aligned with the page.

`skills/**` is Tier H.
